verses.original: לֵאמֹ֡ר הֵ֣ן יְשַׁלַּ֣ח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אִשְׁתּוֹ֩ וְהָלְכָ֨ה מֵאִתּ֜וֹ וְהָיְתָ֣ה לְאִישׁ־ אַחֵ֗ר הֲיָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ ע֔וֹד הֲל֛וֹא חָנ֥וֹף תֶּחֱנַ֖ף הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְאַ֗תְּ זָנִית֙ רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְשׁ֥וֹב אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr hên yə·šal·laḥ ’îš ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw wə·hā·lə·ḵāh mê·’it·tōw wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’îš- ’a·ḥêr hă·yā·šūḇ ’ê·le·hā ‘ō·wḏ hă·lō·w ḥā·nō·wp̄ te·ḥĕ·nap̄ hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hî wə·’at zā·nîṯ rê·‘îm rab·bîm wə·šō·wḇ ’ê·lay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him to marry . . . another can he ever return to her Would not such a land be completely defiled . . . But you have played the harlot with many lovers and you would return to Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: ELES dizem: Se um homem despedir sua mulher, e ela o deixar, e se ajuntar a outro homem, porventura tornará ele outra vez para ela? Não se poluirá de todo aquela terra? Ora, tu te prostituíste com muitos amantes; mas ainda assim, torna para mim, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי־ עֵינַ֨יִךְ עַל־ שְׁפָיִ֜ם וּרְאִ֗י אֵיפֹה֙ לֹ֣א שֻׁגַּלְתְּ עַל־ דְּרָכִים֙ יָשַׁ֣בְתְּ לָהֶ֔ם כַּעֲרָבִ֖י בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַתַּחֲנִ֣יפִי אֶ֔רֶץ בִּזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ וּבְרָעָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’î- ‘ê·na·yiḵ ‘al- šə·p̄ā·yim ū·rə·’î ’ê·p̄ōh lō šug·galt ‘al- də·rā·ḵîm yā·šaḇt lā·hem ka·‘ă·rā·ḇî bam·miḏ·bār wat·ta·ḥă·nî·p̄î ’e·reṣ biz·nū·ṯa·yiḵ ū·ḇə·rā·‘ā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Lift up your eyes to the barren heights and see Is there any place where you have not been violated You sat beside the highways waiting for your lovers like a nomad in the desert You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness
verses.literalPt: Levanta os teus olhos aos altos, e vê: onde não te prostituíste? Nos caminhos te assentavas para eles, como o árabe no deserto; assim poluíste a terra com as tuas fornicações e com a tua malícia.

verses.original: וַיִּמָּנְע֣וּ רְבִבִ֔ים וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ ל֣וֹא הָיָ֑ה וּמֵ֨צַח אִשָּׁ֤ה זוֹנָה֙ הָ֣יָה לָ֔ךְ מֵאַ֖נְתְּ הִכָּלֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·mā·nə·‘ū rə·ḇi·ḇîm ū·mal·qō·wōš lō·w hā·yāh ū·mê·ṣaḥ ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh hā·yāh lāḵ mê·’ant hik·kā·lêm
verses.literal: Therefore the showers have been withheld and no spring rains have fallen Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute . . . you refuse to be ashamed
verses.literalPt: Por isso foram retiradas as chuvas, e não houve chuva serôdia; mas tu tens a fronte de uma prostituta, e não queres ter vergonha.

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא מֵעַ֔תָּה קָרָאתִי לִ֖י אָבִ֑י אַלּ֥וּף נְעֻרַ֖י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w mê·‘at·tāh qå̄·rå̄·ṯī lî ’ā·ḇî ’al·lūp̄ nə·‘u·ray ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Have you not just called to Me My Father You are my friend from youth
verses.literalPt: Ao menos desde agora não chamarás por mim, dizendo: Pai meu, tu és o guia da minha mocidade?

verses.original: הֲיִנְטֹ֣ר לְעוֹלָ֔ם אִם־ יִשְׁמֹ֖ר לָנֶ֑צַח הִנֵּ֥ה דִבַּרְתִּי וַתַּעֲשִׂ֥י הָרָע֖וֹת וַתּוּכָֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·yin·ṭōr lə·‘ō·w·lām ’im- yiš·mōr lā·ne·ṣaḥ hin·nêh ḏib·bar·tī wat·ta·‘ă·śî hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ wat·tū·ḵāl
verses.literal: Will He be angry forever . . . Will He be indignant to the end This you have spoken but you keep doing all the evil you can
verses.literalPt: Conservará ele para sempre a sua ira? Ou a guardará continuamente? Eis que tens falado e feito quantas maldades pudeste.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י בִּימֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הֲ‍ֽרָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֹלְכָ֨ה הִ֜יא עַל־ כָּל־ הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַּ וְאֶל־ תַּ֛חַת כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָ֖ן וַתִּזְנִי־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay bî·mê yō·šî·yā·hū ham·me·leḵ hărā·’î·ṯā ’ă·šer ‘ā·śə·ṯāh mə·šu·ḇāh yiś·rā·’êl hō·lə·ḵāh hî ‘al- kāl- har gā·ḇō·ah wə·’el- ta·ḥaṯ kāl- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān wat·tiz·nî- šām
verses.literal: Now in the days of King Josiah the LORD said to me Have you seen what faithless Israel has done She has gone up on every high . . . hill and under every green tree to prostitute herself there
verses.literalPt: Disse mais o SENHOR nos dias do rei Josias: Viste o que fez a rebelde Israel? Ela foi a todo o monte alto, e debaixo de toda a árvore verde, e ali andou prostituindo-se.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אַחֲרֵ֨י עֲשׂוֹתָ֧הּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֛לֶּה אֵלַ֥י תָּשׁ֖וּב וְלֹא־ שָׁ֑בָה וַתֵּרֶאה בָּגוֹדָ֥ה אֲחוֹתָ֖הּ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’a·ḥă·rê ‘ă·śō·w·ṯāh ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh ’ê·lay tā·šūḇ wə·lō- šā·ḇāh wat·tē·rɛh bā·ḡō·w·ḏāh ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯāh yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: I thought that after she had done all these things she would return to Me But she did not return and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it
verses.literalPt: E eu disse: Depois que fizer tudo isto, voltará para mim; mas não voltou; e viu isto a sua aleivosa irmã Judá.

verses.original: וָאֵ֗רֶא כִּ֤י עַל־ כָּל־ אֹדוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽאֲפָה֙ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁלַּחְתִּ֕יהָ וָאֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ סֵ֥פֶר כְּרִיתֻתֶ֖יהָ אֵלֶ֑יהָ וְלֹ֨א יָֽרְאָ֜ה בֹּֽגֵדָ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ אֲחוֹתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ וַתִּ֥זֶן גַּם־ הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re kî ‘al- kāl- ’ō·ḏō·wṯ ’ă·šer ni·’ă·p̄āh mə·šu·ḇāh yiś·rā·’êl šil·laḥ·tî·hā wā·’et·tên ’eṯ- sê·p̄er kə·rî·ṯu·ṯe·hā ’ê·le·hā wə·lō yā·rə·’āh bō·ḡê·ḏāh yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯāh wat·tê·leḵ wat·ti·zen gam- hî
verses.literal: She saw that because . . . . . . faithless Israel had committed adultery I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away Yet that unfaithful sister Judah had no fear . . . and prostituted herself as well
verses.literalPt: E vi que, por causa de tudo isto, por ter cometido adultério a rebelde Israel, a despedi, e lhe dei a sua carta de divórcio, que a aleivosa Judá, sua irmã, não temeu; mas se foi e também ela mesma se prostituiu.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ מִקֹּ֣ל זְנוּתָ֔הּ וַתֶּחֱנַ֖ף אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּנְאַ֥ף אֶת־ הָאֶ֖בֶן וְאֶת־ הָעֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh miq·qōl zə·nū·ṯāh wat·te·ḥĕ·nap̄ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tin·’ap̄ ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen wə·’eṯ- hā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: Indifferent to . . . her own infidelity Israel had defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que pela fama da sua prostituição, contaminou a terra; porque adulterou com a pedra e com a madeira.

verses.original: וְגַם־ בְּכָל־ זֹ֗את לֹא־ שָׁ֨בָה אֵלַ֜י בָּגוֹדָ֧ה אֲחוֹתָ֛הּ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּכָל־ לִבָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י אִם־ בְּשֶׁ֖קֶר נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- šā·ḇāh ’ê·lay bā·ḡō·w·ḏāh ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯāh yə·hū·ḏāh bə·ḵāl lib·bāh kî ’im- bə·še·qer nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Yet in spite of all this her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart but only . . . in pretense declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E, contudo, apesar de tudo isso a sua aleivosa irmã Judá não voltou para mim de todo o seu coração, mas falsamente, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י צִדְּקָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖הּ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבֹּגֵדָ֖ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ṣid·də·qāh nap̄·šāh mə·šu·ḇāh yiś·rā·’êl mib·bō·ḡê·ḏāh yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than unfaithful Judah
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR me disse: Já a rebelde Israel mostrou-se mais justa do que a aleivosa Judá.

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְקָֽרָאתָ֩ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה צָפ֗וֹנָה וְ֠אָמַרְתָּ שׁ֣וּבָה מְשֻׁבָ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לֽוֹא־ אַפִּ֥יל פָּנַ֖י בָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ חָסִ֤יד אֲנִי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א אֶטּ֖וֹר לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lōḵ wə·qā·rā·ṯā ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wə·’ā·mar·tā šū·ḇāh mə·šu·ḇāh yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh lō·w- ’ap·pîl pā·nay bā·ḵem kî- ḥā·sîḏ ’ă·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh lō ’eṭ·ṭō·wr lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Go proclaim this message toward the north Return O faithless Israel declares the LORD I will no longer look on you with anger . . . for I am merciful declares the LORD I will not be angry forever
verses.literalPt: Vai, pois, e apregoa estas palavras para o lado norte, e dize: Volta, ó rebelde Israel, diz o SENHOR, e não farei cair a minha ira sobre ti; porque misericordioso sou, diz o SENHOR, e não conservarei para sempre a minha ira.

verses.original: אַ֚ךְ דְּעִ֣י עֲוֺנֵ֔ךְ כִּ֛י בַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖יִךְ פָּשָׁ֑עַתְּ וַתְּפַזְּרִ֨י אֶת־ דְּרָכַ֜יִךְ לַזָּרִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת כָּל־ עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן וּבְקוֹלִ֥י לֹא־ שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ də·‘î ‘ă·wō·nêḵ kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·ha·yiḵ pā·šā·‘at wat·tə·p̄az·zə·rî ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵa·yiḵ laz·zā·rîm ta·ḥaṯ kāl- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān ū·ḇə·qō·w·lî lō- šə·ma‘·tem nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Only acknowledge your guilt that you have rebelled against the LORD your God You have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every green tree and have not obeyed My voice declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Somente reconhece a tua iniqüidade, que transgrediste contra o SENHOR teu Deus; e estendeste os teus caminhos aos estranhos, debaixo de toda a árvore verde, e não deste ouvidos à minha voz, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: שׁ֣וּבוּ בָנִ֤ים שׁוֹבָבִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י בָּעַ֣לְתִּי בָכֶ֑ם וְלָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם אֶחָ֣ד מֵעִ֗יר וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ מִמִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇū ḇā·nîm šō·w·ḇā·ḇîm nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ’ā·nō·ḵî bā·‘al·tî ḇā·ḵem wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem ’e·ḥāḏ mê·‘îr ū·šə·na·yim mim·miš·pā·ḥāh wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Return O faithless children declares the LORD for I am your master and I will take you one from a city and two from a family and bring you to Zion
verses.literalPt: Convertei-vos, ó filhos rebeldes, diz o SENHOR; pois eu vos desposei; e vos tomarei, a um de uma cidade, e a dois de uma família; e vos levarei a Sião.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים כְּלִבִּ֑י וְרָע֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם דֵּעָ֥ה וְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem rō·‘îm kə·lib·bî wə·rā·‘ū ’eṯ·ḵem dê·‘āh wə·haś·kêl
verses.literal: Then I will give you shepherds after My own heart who will feed you with knowledge and understanding
verses.literalPt: E dar-vos-ei pastores segundo o meu coração, os quais vos apascentarão com ciência e com inteligência.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כִּ֣י תִרְבּוּ֩ וּפְרִיתֶ֨ם בָּאָ֜רֶץ בַּיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵ֙מָּה֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לֹא־ יֹ֣אמְרוּ ע֗וֹד אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל־ לֵ֑ב וְלֹ֤א יִזְכְּרוּ־ בוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִפְקֹ֔דוּ וְלֹ֥א יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî ṯir·bū ū·p̄ə·rî·ṯem bā·’ā·reṣ bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh nə·’um- Yah·weh lō- yō·mə·rū ‘ō·wḏ ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh wə·lō ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- lêḇ wə·lō yiz·kə·rū- ḇōw wə·lō yip̄·qō·ḏū wə·lō yê·‘ā·śeh ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: In those days . . . when you multiply and increase in the land declares the LORD they will no longer discuss the ark of the covenant of the LORD It will never come to mind and no one will remember it or miss it nor . . . will another one be made
verses.literalPt: E sucederá que, quando vos multiplicardes e frutificardes na terra, naqueles dias, diz o SENHOR, nunca mais se dirá: A arca da aliança do SENHOR, nem lhes virá ao coração; nem dela se lembrarão, nem a visitarão; nem se fará outra.

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא יִקְרְא֤וּ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ כִּסֵּ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְנִקְוּ֨וּ אֵלֶ֧יהָ כָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא־ יֵלְכ֣וּ ע֔וֹד אַחֲרֵ֕י שְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֥ם הָרָֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî yiq·rə·’ū lî·rū·šā·lim kis·sê Yah·weh wə·niqw·wū ’ê·le·hā ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim lə·šêm Yah·weh lî·rū·šā·lim wə·lō- yê·lə·ḵū ‘ō·wḏ ’a·ḥă·rê šə·ri·rūṯ lib·bām hā·rā‘
verses.literal: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD and all the nations will be gathered in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD They will no longer . . . follow . . . the stubbornness of their evil hearts
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo chamarão a Jerusalém o trono do SENHOR, e todas as nações se ajuntarão a ela, em nome do SENHOR, em Jerusalém; e nunca mais andarão segundo o propósito do seu coração maligno.

verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה יֵלְכ֥וּ בֵית־ יְהוּדָ֖ה עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְיָבֹ֤אוּ יַחְדָּו֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן עַל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִנְחַ֖לְתִּי אֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh yê·lə·ḵū ḇêṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘al- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·yā·ḇō·’ū yaḥ·dāw mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hin·ḥal·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave to your fathers as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: Naqueles dias andará a casa de Judá com a casa de Israel; e virão juntas da terra do norte, para a terra que dei em herança a vossos pais.

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֵ֚יךְ אֲשִׁיתֵ֣ךְ בַּבָּנִ֔ים וְאֶתֶּן־ לָךְ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֔ה נַחֲלַ֥ת צְבִ֖י צִבְא֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וָאֹמַ֗ר אָבִי֙ תִּקְרְאוּ לִ֔י וּמֵאַחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א תָשׁוּבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·mar·tî ’êḵ ’ă·šî·ṯêḵ bab·bā·nîm wə·’et·ten- lāḵ ’e·reṣ ḥem·dāh na·ḥă·laṯ ṣə·ḇî ṣiḇ·’ō·wṯ gō·w·yim wā·’ō·mar ’ā·ḇî tiq·rə·ʾū lî ū·mê·’a·ḥă·ray lō ṯå̄·šū·ḇū
verses.literal: Then I said How I long to make you My sons and give you a desirable land the most beautiful inheritance of all the nations I thought you would call Me . . . Father and never turn away from following Me
verses.literalPt: Mas eu dizia: Como te porei entre os filhos, e te darei a terra desejável, a excelente herança dos exércitos das nações? Mas eu disse: Tu me chamarás meu pai, e de mim não te desviarás.

verses.original: אָכֵ֛ן בָּגְדָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵרֵעָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן בְּגַדְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên bā·ḡə·ḏāh ’iš·šāh mê·rê·‘āh kên bə·ḡaḏ·tem bî bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But as a woman may betray her husband so you have betrayed Me O house of Israel declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Deveras, como a mulher se aparta aleivosamente do seu marido, assim aleivosamente te houveste comigo, ó casa de Israel, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: ק֚וֹל עַל־ שְׁפָיִ֣ים נִשְׁמָ֔ע בְּכִ֥י תַחֲנוּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י הֶעֱוּוּ֙ אֶת־ דַּרְכָּ֔ם שָׁכְח֖וּ אֶת־ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ‘al- šə·p̄ā·yîm niš·mā‘ bə·ḵî ṯa·ḥă·nū·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kî he·‘ĕw·wū ’eṯ- dar·kām šā·ḵə·ḥū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: A voice is heard on the barren heights the children of Israel weeping and begging for mercy because they have perverted their ways and forgotten the LORD their God
verses.literalPt: Nos lugares altos se ouviu uma voz, pranto e súplicas dos filhos de Israel; porquanto perverteram o seu caminho, e se esqueceram do SENHOR seu Deus.

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ בָּנִ֣ים שׁוֹבָבִ֔ים אֶרְפָּ֖ה מְשׁוּבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם הִנְנוּ֙ אָתָ֣נוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šû·b̲û bā·nîm šō·w·ḇā·ḇîm ’er·pāh mə·šū·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem hin·nū ’ā·ṯā·nū lāḵ kî ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Return O faithless children and I will heal your faithlessness Here we are We come to You for You are the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Voltai, ó filhos rebeldes, eu curarei as vossas rebeliões. Eis-nos aqui, vimos a ti; porque tu és o SENHOR nosso Deus.

verses.original: אָכֵ֥ן לַשֶּׁ֛קֶר מִגְּבָע֖וֹת הָמ֣וֹן הָרִ֑ים אָכֵן֙ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên laš·še·qer mig·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ hā·mō·wn hā·rîm ’ā·ḵên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū tə·šū·‘aṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Surely deception comes from the hills and commotion from the mountains Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Certamente em vão se confia nos outeiros e na multidão das montanhas; deveras no SENHOR nosso Deus está a salvação de Israel.

verses.original: וְהַבֹּ֗שֶׁת אָֽכְלָ֛ה אֶת־ יְגִ֥יעַ אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵ֑ינוּ אֶת־ צֹאנָם֙ וְאֶת־ בְּקָרָ֔ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bō·šeṯ ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’eṯ- yə·ḡî·a‘ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū min·nə·‘ū·rê·nū ’eṯ- ṣō·nām wə·’eṯ- bə·qā·rām ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: From our youth that shameful god has consumed what our fathers have worked for their flocks and herds their sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Porque a confusão devorou o trabalho de nossos pais desde a nossa mocidade; as suas ovelhas e o seu gado, os seus filhos e as suas filhas.

verses.original: נִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה בְּבָשְׁתֵּ֗נוּ וּֽתְכַסֵּנוּ֮ כְּלִמָּתֵנוּ֒ כִּי֩ לַיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ חָטָ֗אנוּ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ וַאֲבוֹתֵ֔ינוּ מִנְּעוּרֵ֖ינוּ וְעַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: niš·kə·ḇāh bə·ḇā·šə·tê·nū ū·ṯə·ḵas·sê·nū kə·lim·mā·ṯê·nū kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ḥā·ṭā·nū ’ă·naḥ·nū wa·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū min·nə·‘ū·rê·nū wə·‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wə·lō šā·ma‘·nū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Let us lie down in our shame let our disgrace . . . cover us We have sinned against the LORD our God both we and our fathers from our youth even to this day we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Deitemo-nos em nossa vergonha; e cubra-nos a nossa confusão, porque pecamos contra o SENHOR nosso Deus, nós e nossos pais, desde a nossa mocidade até o dia de hoje; e não demos ouvidos à voz do SENHOR nosso Deus.
